summary.intent: Clear outstanding human UAT verification debt for phase 19.1 (extract-core-crypto-sdk-as-shared-package), which had 8 unresolved items in its VERIFICATION.md.
summary.outcome: All 9 UAT tests for phase 19.1 passed using a Puppeteer-driven headed browser session with automated OTP auth. Verification debt dropped from 18 to 10 items. A previously undetected browser-only fetch binding bug in the BYO IPFS pinning providers was discovered and documented.

repo: Email OTP codes are printed to the API dev server stdout in local dev, enabling fully automated browser login without manual intervention.
The e2e suite authenticates via a real SIWE flow using an injected mock EIP-6963 wallet (@johanneskares/wallet-mock) — no localStorage hacks or env bypasses.
The app uses hash navigation (#/files, #/bin) to avoid full page reloads during navigation.

Pinning mode ('cipherbox only' vs 'external only') is stored per-vault account and controls which upload code path executes; changing it triggers a background migration job requiring TEE_WORKER_URL/TEE_WORKER_SECRET env vars (not configured locally).
The recycle bin displays 0 B for file sizes — this appears to be a cosmetic display-only issue since restored files show the correct size.

code.finding: fetch is stored as `this.fetchFn = options?.fetchFn ?? globalThis.fetch` without binding — calling it as `this.fetchFn(url, ...)` throws 'Illegal invocation' TypeError in browsers. Fix: `globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis)`. This means BYO/external-only upload has never worked in a real browser; Node.js tests pass because Node fetch is not this-sensitive.
Identical unbound fetch bug as kubo-provider.ts — same one-line fix required.
Client never passes fetchFn to KuboProvider constructor, so the provider always falls back to the unbound globalThis.fetch reference.

loginViaWallet drives the real SIWE→Core Kit flow: waits for [data-testid='wallet-login-button'] to be enabled, clicks it, selects 'Mock Wallet' from .wallet-connector-list, then races waitForURL('**/files') against [data-testid='device-waiting'] to detect the requiredShare outcome.
Folder creation dialog: trigger via .file-browser-new-folder-button, input is #folder-name-input, submit via .dialog-button--primary[type='submit'].
Move dialog: trigger right-click → Move to..., folders listed in .move-dialog-folder-list as .move-dialog-folder-item, confirm with .dialog-button--primary containing text 'Move'.
Recycle bin: nav via [data-testid='nav-item-bin'], items use [data-testid^='bin-item-'] prefix selector, restore/permanent-delete via right-click context menu.

workflow: Puppeteer MCP can drive the full UAT flow autonomously (navigate, fill forms, click, evaluate JS) — eliminates manual browser testing for web app UAT.
When an upload fails at 0% with no network requests, the error is synchronous and pre-fetch; reading it from the React fiber (reactFiber internals on the DOM node) is the fastest diagnosis path.
Puppeteer frame detachment on page reload requires re-navigation (puppeteer_navigate back to the URL) before any further evaluate calls will succeed.
UAT results should be committed on a feature branch rather than directly to main, per repo convention.

friction: Account was configured with 'external only' pinning mode pointing to an unreachable BYO IPFS node (192.168.133.12:5002), causing an instant silent failure with zero network requests before the real test could run.
Upload error string was not surfaced in network logs or visible UI text — required reading it from React fiber internals via page.evaluate.
Page reload during pinning mode settings save caused Puppeteer frame detachment, requiring full re-navigation and re-authentication.
Had to authenticate via OTP three separate times across the session (initial login, frame detachment recovery, logout→re-login lifecycle test).
TEE_WORKER_URL / TEE_WORKER_SECRET are not configured locally, causing a non-fatal warning logged during the pinning mode migration job that initially looked like a blocking error.
open_items: Browser fetch binding bug in kubo-provider.ts:22 and psa-provider.ts:41 — BYO/dual-pin upload has never worked in a real browser. Two-line fix (globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis)) needs to be applied and tested; phase 21 UAT debt is likely covering this same surface.
Phase 21 (BYO IPFS node) still has 4 uncleared human UAT items — strongly suspected to be blocked by or related to the fetch binding bug.
Phase 35 still has 6 uncleared human UAT items.
